tasks.title: Setup Database Schema for Time Entry Functionality
tasks.description: Implement the Prisma schema for all models related to time entry functionality as defined in the PRD.
tasks.details:
Create Prisma schema files for the following models:
- TimeEntry
- Rate
- WorkReport
- Comment
- Attachment

Ensure all relationships are properly defined including:
- User to TimeEntry (one-to-many)
- User to Rate (one-to-many)
- User to WorkReport (one-to-many)
- TimeEntry to WorkReport (many-to-one)
- WorkReport to Comment (one-to-many)
- WorkReport to Attachment (one-to-many)

Implement the ReportStatus enum as defined in the PRD.

Run the migration using:
```bash
yarn rw prisma migrate dev --name add_time_entry_models
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify schema compiles without errors
2. Run migration in development environment
3. Test database queries to ensure relationships work as expected
4. Validate constraints and defaults
5. Create test data and verify it can be stored and retrieved correctly

tasks.title: Generate GraphQL Schema for Time Entry Models
tasks.description: Define GraphQL types, queries, and mutations for all time entry related models.
tasks.details:
Create GraphQL schema definitions for:

1. Types:
   - TimeEntry
   - Rate
   - WorkReport
   - Comment
   - Attachment
   - ReportStatus (enum)

2. Queries:
   - timeEntries(filters): [TimeEntry!]!
   - timeEntry(id: String!): TimeEntry
   - rates(userId: String, clientId: String, projectId: String): [Rate!]!
   - workReports(userId: String, status: ReportStatus): [WorkReport!]!
   - workReport(id: String!): WorkReport

3. Mutations:
   - createTimeEntry(input: CreateTimeEntryInput!): TimeEntry!
   - updateTimeEntry(id: String!, input: UpdateTimeEntryInput!): TimeEntry!
   - deleteTimeEntry(id: String!): TimeEntry!
   - createRate(input: CreateRateInput!): Rate!
   - updateRate(id: String!, input: UpdateRateInput!): Rate!
   - deleteRate(id: String!): Rate!
   - createWorkReport(input: CreateWorkReportInput!): WorkReport!
   - updateWorkReport(id: String!, input: UpdateWorkReportInput!): WorkReport!
   - updateWorkReportStatus(id: String!, status: ReportStatus!): WorkReport!
   - addCommentToWorkReport(workReportId: String!, content: String!): Comment!
   - addAttachmentToWorkReport(workReportId: String!, file: Upload!): Attachment!

Implement proper authorization directives to ensure users can only access their own data unless they have admin privileges.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Validate schema using GraphQL playground
2. Test each query and mutation with sample data
3. Verify authorization rules work correctly
4. Test edge cases like invalid inputs
5. Verify proper error handling

tasks.title: Implement Time Entry Services
tasks.description: Create service layer for TimeEntry model to handle business logic and database operations.
tasks.details:
Create a TimeEntryService with the following functionality:

1. CRUD operations:
   - createTimeEntry
   - updateTimeEntry
   - deleteTimeEntry
   - getTimeEntry
   - listTimeEntries

2. Business logic:
   - validateTimeEntry: Check for overlapping entries
   - calculateDuration: Auto-calculate duration from start/end times
   - getRecentEntries: Fetch recent entries for quick entry suggestions
   - groupTimeEntriesByDate/Client/Project: For different view options

Implement filtering capabilities for:
- Date range
- Client
- Project
- Department
- Product
- Tags
- Status (submitted in report or not)

Ensure proper error handling and validation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for all service methods
2. Test validation logic with valid and invalid data
3. Test duration calculation with various time inputs
4. Test filtering with different combinations
5. Test error handling scenarios
6. Verify overlapping entry detection works correctly

tasks.title: Implement Rate Management Services
tasks.description: Create service layer for Rate model to handle rate calculations, effective dates, and rate selection logic.
tasks.details:
Create a RateService with the following functionality:

1. CRUD operations:
   - createRate
   - updateRate
   - deleteRate
   - getRate
   - listRates

2. Business logic:
   - getApplicableRates: Get rates applicable for a user on a specific date
   - getEffectiveRate: Determine the most specific applicable rate (project > client > default)
   - validateRateEffectiveDates: Ensure no overlapping effective dates for same rate type
   - bulkUpdateRates: For admin batch operations

Implement logic to handle rate precedence:
1. Project-specific rates
2. Client-specific rates
3. Special rates (overtime, weekend, holiday)
4. Default user rate

Ensure historical rate tracking for accurate reporting on past entries.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for all service methods
2. Test rate selection logic with various scenarios
3. Test effective date handling
4. Verify rate precedence works correctly
5. Test bulk update operations
6. Verify historical rates are preserved

tasks.title: Implement Work Report Services
tasks.description: Create service layer for WorkReport model to handle report creation, submission, and workflow.
tasks.details:
Create a WorkReportService with the following functionality:

1. CRUD operations:
   - createWorkReport
   - updateWorkReport
   - deleteWorkReport
   - getWorkReport
   - listWorkReports

2. Business logic:
   - submitWorkReport: Change status from DRAFT to SUBMITTED
   - approveWorkReport: Change status from SUBMITTED to APPROVED
   - rejectWorkReport: Change status from SUBMITTED to REJECTED
   - markAsPaid: Change status from APPROVED to PAID
   - markAsReceived: Change status from PAID to RECEIVED
   - addTimeEntryToReport: Associate a time entry with a report
   - removeTimeEntryFromReport: Remove a time entry from a report
   - calculateTotals: Update totalHours and totalAmount
   - getUnbilledTimeEntries: Find entries not yet included in a report
   - addComment: Add a comment to a work report
   - addAttachment: Add an attachment to a work report

Implement workflow validation to ensure status transitions follow the defined flow.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for all service methods
2. Test workflow transitions with valid and invalid state changes
3. Test calculation of totals
4. Verify time entry association/removal works correctly
5. Test comment and attachment functionality
6. Verify unbilled time entries are correctly identified

tasks.title: Create Time Entry Form Component
tasks.description: Develop a mobile-first form component for creating and editing time entries with all required fields and validation.
tasks.details:
Create a React component for time entry form with the following features:

1. Form fields:
   - Date (date picker, defaulting to current date)
   - Time Input Method toggle (Start/End Time vs Duration)
   - Start/End Time pickers (conditional)
   - Duration input (hours/minutes, conditional)
   - Rate dropdown (showing applicable rates by effective date)
   - Client dropdown (optional, filtered by user access)
   - Project dropdown (optional, filtered by selected client)
   - Product dropdown (optional)
   - Department dropdown (optional)
   - Description textarea (required)
   - Private Notes textarea (optional)
   - Tags selection (optional, multiple)

2. Functionality:
   - Auto-calculate duration when using start/end time
   - Pre-fill last used values for frequent combinations
   - Form validation
   - Submit handling
   - Cancel/Reset options

Use Shadcn UI components for consistent look and feel. Implement responsive design for mobile-first experience.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for form validation
2. Test auto-calculation of duration
3. Test form submission with valid and invalid data
4. Test responsive design on various screen sizes
5. Verify dropdown filtering works correctly
6. Test with keyboard navigation and screen readers for accessibility
